```python
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

url = "https://www.indeed.com/q-software-developer-jobs.html"
response = requests.get(url)
soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, 'html.parser')

job_titles = []
job_locations = []

for job in soup.find_all("div", class_="jobsearch-SerpJobCard"):
    title = job.find("a", class_="jobtitle").text.strip()
    location = job.find("div", class_="recJobLoc")["data-rc-loc"]
    job_titles.append(title)
    job_locations.append(location)

print(f"Job Titles: {job_titles}")
print(f"Job Locations: {job_locations}")
```
